description: This file contains the implementation of a Microsoft ADO database driver for the ADOdb PHP library, including connection handling, schema metadata retrieval, query execution, and recordset processing.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Represents an ADO database connection using the MS Windows COM interface, providing connection management, schema retrieval, and transaction control.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Represents a recordset from an ADO database query, enabling data retrieval and navigation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ADODB_ado connection object, setting up affected rows handling.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the server such as provider description.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows for the last operation.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using the provided hostname, username, password, and provider.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Maintains a persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables in the database schema.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specific table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional input parameters, returning a recordset.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database connection.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from the database connection.
